mechanism: Selegiline at doses >10mg/day inhibits monoamine oxidase and can potentiate estradiol's effects on serotonin/dopamine systems, with potential for serotonergic interactions; estradiol may also increase selegiline metabolism variability through CYP3A4 effects.
action: Monitor for serotonergic symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia); consider dose adjustment if selegiline exceeds 10mg/day; counsel on dietary tyramine restriction.
